backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app, defining types and state for festivals, mantras, aartis, shlokas, temples, community posts, jap counters, kathayen, and user profiles, with admin/approval helpers and CRUD endpoints.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three confirmed features: replacing OpenRouter with Google Gemini API in aiEngine.ts, updating the AIGuru UI to reference Gemini, and updating .env.example and comments to reflect the Gemini migration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each component, page, hook, and utility in the React frontend.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting that the app uses a user-supplied Google Gemini API key (stored in localStorage) obtained free from Google AI Studio, with no backend exposure.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a #root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, Aarti, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Small card component that renders an aarti's emoji, name, and color as a TanStack Router link navigating to the aarti detail page.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared app shell rendering a sticky devotional header with Om logo and login button, main content outlet, bottom navigation, profile setup modal for new authenticated users, and a footer with Caffeine attribution.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with 8 items (Home, Panchang, Jap, Aarti, Kathayen, Mandir, AI Guru, Profile) using TanStack Router for navigation and active-state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Displays a single chat message bubble for user or AI roles, supporting markdown-like bold/newline rendering and an optional generated image with download functionality.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Shows an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI Guru avatar, used to indicate the AI is composing a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Fetches and displays a daily dharma quote in Hindi and English with a fallback Bhagavad Gita verse, showing a skeleton loader while fetching.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Displays a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi dates when the next one is within 7 days, persisting dismissal state in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Shows a countdown card for the next upcoming Hindu festival fetched via query, and allows downloading a canvas-generated shareable festival countdown image.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders decorative floating lotus petal images as a fixed background layer with CSS keyframe animations at various positions and timings.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing golden radial-gradient halo glow around its children, with configurable size presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Renders a card for a single Katha (Hindu story) with title, category badge, deity emoji, text preview, and tags, linking to the katha detail page.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and optional text as a loading indicator.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout, showing loading state and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: Full-screen animated overlay that appears when 108 mantra repetitions are completed, showing a lotus image, petal burst particles, and a congratulatory message.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Canvas-based animated mala (prayer bead ring) that visually fills 108 beads based on the current count, with a slow rotation and central Om symbol.
Short-lived animation component that bursts three Om symbols outward in different directions, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/PremiumBanner.ts: Dismissible promotional banner advertising a premium subscription with a list of benefits and an upgrade button, persisting dismissal state in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time users to enter their name and create a profile, saving it via the useSetUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders up to four concentric ripple ring animations centered on the component, triggered by an incrementing numeric prop, each fading out after 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Renders a Sanskrit shloka card with Hindi and English meanings, providing copy, share, and canvas-based image download functionality.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: Displays a vrat (fasting) mode dashboard with Brahma Muhurat timing, countdown timers to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates, and fasting trackers.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle switch component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, showing contextual labels and icons based on the active state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: Custom hook managing AI chat state including message history, loading state, sending messages via the AI engine, and clearing the conversation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, jap counter, dharma quotes, festivals, and community posts.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: A React hook that wraps the Web Speech Synthesis API to provide play, pause, resume, and stop controls for text narration, with Hindi voice preference and graceful error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports devotional fonts (Yatra One, Tiro Devanagari Hindi, Poppins), configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH CSS variables for light/dark themes, and defines devotional animations like floating lotus, diya flicker, and mandala spin.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: AI engine module that routes user messages to either Pollinations.ai for free image generation or the Google Gemini API for text responses, with localStorage-based API key management and Hindi/English image-request detection.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Static data file defining zodiac rashi metadata and templated Hindi prediction strings for love and career aspects, used to generate daily horoscope (bhavishya) content for all 12 rashis.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Static dataset of Hindu religious stories (kathas) including full Hindi texts of the Ramayan and Mahabharat epics, typed with category, deity, tags, and approval status fields.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Client-side Hindu Panchang calculation engine implementing Jean Meeus astronomical algorithms to compute sun/moon longitudes, Julian Day numbers, and related calendar data for a central India location.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data arrays for Shlokas and Aartis, including full Hindi and English text for six deities (Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: Aarti collection listing page that displays a grid of aarti cards with emoji icons and links to individual aarti detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti that shows its full text with Hindi/English toggle, and provides copy and share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page with authentication guard that allows admins to manage user approvals, assign roles, and add Dharma quotes via tabbed UI.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: AI chat page component featuring a Gemini API key configuration panel, suggested prompts, and a chat interface with message history and typing indicator.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page that displays approved posts from the backend (with seed/fallback posts), and allows authenticated users to create posts, like, and report them, with an approval-request flow for new users.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated dashboard page that redirects unauthenticated users to home, shows a welcome message with the user's profile name, and triggers a profile setup modal if no profile exists.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page displaying a hero banner, today's Panchang strip, a daily shloka, Ekadashi reminder, premium banner, Dharma quote, and an Aarti section teaser with navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap (mantra chanting) counter page with mantra selection, session and lifetime tap counts synced to the backend, visual ripple/particle/lotus-bloom effects, and localStorage fallback for guest users.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Katha that fetches content from the backend (falling back to static data), supports Hindi/English toggle, and provides text-to-speech narration controls.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Kathayen listing page that merges backend and static katha data, supports tab filtering by category and a search query, and renders each katha as a KathaCard.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: React page for finding Hindu temples, featuring a Google Maps integration button for nearby temples and a list of famous temples with live darshan and maps links.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: React page displaying the Hindu Panchang (almanac) for a selected date, including tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vara, auspicious muhurats, and inauspicious periods with day navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: React profile page for authenticated users showing mantra selection, vrat mode toggle, and logout functionality, with a fallback prompt for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom fonts (Devanagari, Poppins), border radii, shadows, and background images for the app's Hindu aesthetic.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the app's architecture, existing features, and pending feature requests, primarily documenting the migration from OpenRouter to Google Gemini API for AI chat.
